stepTitle: If the design matrix columns are linearly independent, the OLS solution is unique.
stepBody: The owner collects $$n$$ $$=$$ $$30$$ observations and fits an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model with $$29$$ features (e.g., foot traffic, temperature, etc.) with an intercept (30 parameters total). The model is: $$y_{hat,i}$$ $$=$$ $$\theta_{hat,0}$$ + $$\theta_{hat,1} x_{i1}$$ + $$\theta_{hat,2} x_{i2}$$ + ... + $$\theta_{hat,29} x_{i29}$$ Which of the following is always true?
